item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 04/Dec/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of the dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over southern China in the next few days. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. A broad band of clouds is expected to cover the coastal areas of Guangdong gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be cloudier over the region. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the seas east of the Philippines will move towards the vicinity of the central and southern parts of the Philippines in the next couple of days, and then weaken gradually.
